## New commands
- `google-gemini`: send a prompt to Google Gemini and get the answer with cited sources; continue a conversation with `--subsequent-request-token`.
- `instagram-reels`: list the Reels of a public Instagram account by `--handle`, with token pagination.

## Changed
- `booking-search`: new `--next-page-token` flag for token pagination. `--page` still works but can return duplicates on large destinations.

Upgrade: `hasdata update`
